name: fp_vuln_scan_auth_sweep
label: false_positive
description: An authenticated vulnerability scan from the scanning appliance: a burst of failed logons where credentials do not apply, then successful ones where they do, across many hosts in minutes.
detectable_as: Textbook password spraying. Same shape, same rate, same spread of targets.
why_hard: The only reliable separator is the source address being a known scanner, which is site knowledge a detection cannot infer from the events.
